lead: Headcount, tenure, languages, qualifications — two to six of them, though four is the point at which a team described by numbers stops sounding like people.

stats.title: The value is the term
stats.text: Each figure is a description list entry: the number is defined by the label under it.

stats.title: The unit sits beside it
stats.text: Smaller and quieter, so the number itself keeps the weight.

stats.title: A figure can go without a unit
stats.text: A plain count needs nothing after it, and the space closes up.

stats.title: Rules start each figure
stats.text: A separator between two columns lands in the middle of the band and stops reading as one.
